description: This Java class 'SubscriptionsReader' manages local subscriptions for a pub/sub system, allowing lookup of subscribers based on topics and filters. It provides methods to create instances, retrieve subscribers, and check topic subscriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionsReader
classes.description: Handles reading and querying subscription data including topics, subscribers, and filters.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty subscription reader with no subscriptions or filters.

methods.name: fromImmutableMaps
methods.description: Constructs a subscription reader from immutable maps of topics to subscribers and subscribers to filters.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves the set of subscribers interested in at least one of the specified topics, considering their filters.

methods.name: containsTopic
methods.description: Checks if a specific topic has any subscribers.
